avis.titre: Unique Korean Serum With a Real Micro-Needling SensationUnique Korean Serum With a Real Micro-Needling Sensation
avis.texte: This serum definitely gives a unique skincare experience! When applying it, you can actually feel the tiny micro-spicules on the skin — almost like a very light micro-needle sensation. It feels a little tingly at first, but not unbearable, and it really makes the product feel like it’s actively working. The texture absorbs well and leaves my skin looking smooth, hydrated, and glowing. After continued use, my skin started looking more refined, refreshed, and healthier overall. I also noticed my skin felt softer and looked more radiant, especially the next morning. One thing I appreciate is that despite the micro-needle feeling, the serum still feels lightweight and layers nicely with the rest of my skincare routine. The packaging also looks very luxurious and hygienic with the easy-to-use pump bottle. If you enjoy Korean skincare and want a serum that feels innovative and effective, this one is definitely worth trying. The micro-spicule sensation may surprise you at first, but it gives a very professional skincare feel at home. Great product for achieving a smoother, glowing complexion!

I have mixed feelings about this serum and I am still deciding how I feel about it. So far, it has made my skin feel soft after using it. I do notice the prickly feeling when I apply it, and that took me by surprise at first. I usually rub it in until I do not notice the feeling anymore. I do not use it on my whole face at one time, but instead apply it to small sections. For me, this is not something I plan to use every day. I think it is a product that I will use only when I feel like my skin needs a little extra attention. I will keep using it and see how my skin responds over time.

avis.titre: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Lightweight serum with a beautiful glow
avis.texte: I really enjoy the Dr.Melaxin Cyano Pink Spicule Serum with Vitamin B12. The texture is lightweight and absorbs nicely into my skin without leaving a heavy or sticky feeling. It feels comfortable to use as part of my daily skincare routine. After applying it, my skin feels smoother, more hydrated, and has a healthier-looking glow. I like that it gives my complexion a refreshed appearance and feels genuinely effective in improving overall skin hydration and radiance. Considering the results, I also find it to be good value for money, as a little goes a long way and it delivers noticeable benefits without needing a complicated routine. The packaging feels premium and the bottle is easy to use, allowing for a clean and controlled application. The formula feels gentle while still giving that extra skincare boost. Overall, this is a high-quality and effective serum with a pleasant texture, beautiful finish, and luxurious feel. It has become a worthwhile addition to my skincare routine for maintaining hydrated, radiant-looking skin at a reasonable value.
Big fan of Dr Melaxin products & this one is one of my favorites. I'm in my 60s & I've had good results with this product

The serum is pink, non-sticky, non-oily, non-pilling, and absorbent. It wasn’t so moisturizing but not drying either. My skin felt some softness after applying. No scent. Expect to feel tingles during application. It wasn’t painful. No redness. It was an interesting itchy sensation on the skin. It goes away quickly. On this page it says to avoid rubbing it in and tap/press instead to prevent irritation. The ingredient list seems safe. The micro sized spicules are made from sea sponges. They are used to enhance the absorption of ingredients and revitalize complexion. They’re seen as a natural alternative to microneedling. Since this is exfoliating, I wonder if we could use this daily. This serum reminds me of the viral VT Cosmetics Reedle Shot due to the spicules. The bottle and lid is plastic. The serum came inside the manufacturer's box with a seal. It was made in Korea, expires on 2027/06/17 and is good for 12 months after opening. Right now it’s too soon to tell if it’s doing anything for my skin. I will update my review in the future if necessary. -Ingredients- Water, Glycerin, Butylene Glycol, Niacinamide, 1,2-Hexanediol, Cetyl Ethylhexanoate, Carbomer, Cetearyl Olivate, Hydroxyacetophenone,Sorbitan Olivate, Tromethamine, Calcium Gluconate, Ethylhexylglycerin, Hydrolyzed Sponge, Adenosine, Cyanocobalamin, Disodium EDTA, Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis (Sweet Almond) Fruit Extract, TremellaFuciformis (Mushroom) Extract, Tabebuia Impetiginosa Bark Extract, Coffea Arabica (Coffee)

avis.titre: Helped Tighten My Skin & Minimize Pores
avis.texte: I’ve loved the Dr. Melaxin Cyano Pink Spicule Serum! The bottle is small, but it lasted me around 6 months since I only use one pump every other night. When I first started using it, I noticed a tingling sensation, but over time my skin adjusted and I barely notice it now. I’ve definitely seen my pores appear smaller and my skin feels tighter and smoother after using it.

I would give this zero stars if I could. It feels like small shards of fiberglass are being rubbed into your skin. Made me break out in hives. It's been five days now and I've had hives all over my face and neck.

avis.titre: Noticeable Brightening and Smoothness in Just Days
avis.texte: I tried the Dr. Melaxin Cemenrete Cyano Pink Spicule Serum and was impressed with how quickly it smoothed and brightened my skin. The texture absorbs fast without feeling heavy, and I could feel a gentle tightening right after applying. After a few days, my skin looked clearer and more even. The only downside is the slight tingling from the spicules, but it fades quickly. Overall, a great serum if you want glow and improved texture.

The pink color really jumps out on this product. This is a face serum with a liquid consistency. It does seem to be slightly irritating. Although the listing says it’s for under the eyes, the instructions say it is for the entire face. The price seems a little high considering how tiny the product is (1 oz). But you don’t have to use very much, especially if you’re only wearing it under your eyes. This goes on clean, and does not leave a greasy feel. It feels almost like a moisturizer. It is scented although it’s not very strong. It’s a rather pleasant scent.
The worst serum ever , I don’t even have sensitive skin and it irritated my skin ! Don’t waste ur money !

EDITED: You have to be very careful when this product, the tingling effect irritated my skin pretty badly overtime, and I had to stop using it because I started reacting to all skincare I was using after this one. Burning and eventual flaking of the skin. I think I messed up my skin barrier with daily use of this product, and it probably should only be used similarly to an exfoliator once in a while and not on a daily basis. ———————————- I'm a fan of Korean skin care and pretty much use only things produced by Korean companies. I've heard about this brand, and I've tried a couple of other things from them, which are usually either hit or miss for me. But this sounded promising enough to try. The packaging is good as usual, the box came sealed, there's an expiration date both on the bottle and on the box. The ingredients and descriptions are in both English and Korean, so you don't need to resort to an online translator. I'm not sure why, but my pump started working immediately out of the box, as opposed to usually having to press a bunch of times on new products before they start dispensing anything. I know the box was sealed, but still makes me scratch my head. The serum is of a thicker toner consistency, it's very pink in color, but I know they didn't add anything artificial in terms of coloring, so it must come from some ingredients. There is no smell that I can detect. It does tingle when you apply and rub it, so I'm guessing it's the promised spicules. Not sure how neede

avis.titre: Easy to apply, slight tingling sensation
avis.texte: This serum is easy to apply and quickly absorbed. As noted by others, there is a slight tingling sensation when first applying, but it does goes away quickly. Product is not sticky or tacky when applied and does not pill. A little bit goes a long way! Highly recommend.
